candidates.reason: The ledger line measured 0/3 in this round and produced no evidence-backed advantage to transfer. Constructing a hybrid from model claims alone is prohibited by the round rules.

selection_reason: Candidate A won on every predeclared dimension at once: 3/3 generation success versus 2/3 for B+A and 0/3 for v2.9, 11/11 on the frozen operational evaluator versus the incumbent's 2/11, the lowest total provider cost, the lowest total wall time, zero manual interventions, and every release gate green. loop_closure.decision: Round 007 is the final champion-challenger round on the Duplicate Finder workload.
rationale: The v2 ledger line lost all seven rounds (0/3, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, 0/3). Its architectural question is answered.
Generation success on this workload moved from 1/3 in round 002 to 3/3 here, so the measurable headroom on it is exhausted.

The workload is a single-file 177-216 line utility. Its component_decisions record only the Python standard library, so it does not exercise the reuse-first composition path that the product claims as its core.
Further rounds would keep optimizing a benchmark that cannot measure the capability the system exists to provide.
loop_closure.successor_rationale: The successor measures assembly of real evidence-backed components behind contracts, which is the claim the Duplicate Finder benchmark never tested.
